title: Trump’s son-in-law: business or politics? – level 1
paragraphs: Jared Kushner is Donald Trump’s son-in-law. He works as a very important diplomat for the United States. But he also has his own business.

Some people worry about his foreign money and business. But he still has an important job in the government. Kushner talks to leaders in other countries to help stop wars in places like Ukraine. Many leaders like to talk to him because he is part of the president’s family.
But some people say that mixing family, money, and government work can cause problems. Kushner stays very close to the president, so his power is very strong today.

words.d: the husband of a person’s daughter
an official who represents their country in other countries
